record.dic_text:
0422 'alah {a:-la:'}

字根型; TWOT - 94; 動詞

欽定本 - swear 4, curse 1, adjure 1; 6

1) 發誓, 咒詛
   1a) (Qal)
       1a1) 發誓, 發誓言 (在上帝面前)
       1a2) 咒詛
   1b) (Hiphil)
       1b1) 使發誓說真話, 嚴令
record.edic_text:
0422 'alah {aw-law'}

a primitive root; TWOT - 94; v

AV - swear 4, curse 1, adjure 1; 6

1) to swear, curse
   1a) (Qal)
       1a1) to swear, take an oath (before God)
       1a2) to curse
   1b) (Hiphil)
       1b1) to put under oath, adjure
       1b2) to put under a curse
